integrity: The universal proof is analytic. Exact symbolic derivative checks and numerical feasible-orientation checks supplement the proof but do not constitute independent review or an exhaustive computational certification. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns Euclidean stadiums consisting of a positive-length straight segment plus a closed disk; the circular endpoint has nonunique rotated optimal squares. It does not extend to arbitrary rounded rectangles, general centrally symmetric bodies, or noisy measurements.
title: Sharp rectangle capacity and perimeter extremizer of Euclidean stadiums
